title: Determination Basis: Interest Allowance on Contributions Credited Back after a Contribution Rate Appeal
content:
**Basis.** On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, an appeal interest allowance is added to the credit balance claimed in a refund request, on the contributions credited back within the appeal credit months, 12, to the quarter most recently credited back because a contribution rate was reduced on appeal — the credited-back quarter. The allowance is the class's monthly late payment interest rate times those credited-back contributions times a number of interest months, rounded to the cent. The refund requested may exceed the credit balance only by this allowance.

**Records read.** The account's balance history (credits booked because a rate was reduced on appeal, and the contribution payments received for the credited-back quarter) and the employer's appeals under Unemployment Insurance Appeals on its contribution rate — the Lower Authority Appeal — Employer Contribution Rate docket — with each appeal's filing date, decision outcome and decision mailing date.

## The credited-back quarter and the contributions

- The credited-back quarter is the quarter of the most recent credit booked because a contribution rate was reduced on appeal.
- The contributions are the credits of that kind booked to that quarter within the 12 months counted back from the day of the request, in whole months by the entry dates of the ledger entries.

## Interest start date

The interest start date follows the employer's most recently decided contribution rate appeal (the one whose decision was mailed most recently) and the payment of the credited-back quarter's contributions:

| Appeal decided as | Credited-back quarter's last contribution payment received | Interest runs from |
|---|---|---|
| Reversed or modified | On or after the appeal's filing date | That payment's date |
| Reversed or modified | Before the appeal's filing date | The appeal's filing date |
| Any other case, including no contributions credited back within 12 months | — | No interest months; no allowance is added |

**Interest months** are the whole months from the interest start date to the day of the request, plus one for the month in progress.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, monthly rate 0.01, request on 25 August 2026)

USD 620.00 of contributions were credited back to the third quarter of 2025 in May 2026. The rate appeal was filed on 10 February 2026 and decided as modified.

1. **Payment before filing.** The quarter's last contribution payment was received on 31 October 2025, before 10 February 2026, so interest runs from 10 February 2026. Whole months to 25 August 2026: 6; plus one: 7. Allowance: 0.01 times 620.00 times 7, that is **USD 43.40**.
2. **Payment on or after filing.** Had the last payment been received on 2 March 2026, interest would run from 2 March 2026: 5 whole months, plus one, 6 months, and an allowance of **USD 37.20**.
3. **Appeal affirmed.** Had the appeal been decided as affirmed, no allowance would be added.
4. **Class with no interest.** For a class whose monthly late payment interest rate is 0, the allowance works out to USD 0.00.
